## UQAT IRF

I am currently working to obtain my M.S. at Université du Québec en Abitibi-Temiscamingue (UQAT). My degree is in écologie et aménagement des écosystèmes forestiers (ecology and management of forest ecosystems). At UQAT, I am part of the l'Institut de recherche sur les forêts (IRF, Forest research institute). Under the supervision of Maxence Martin and Xavier Cavard, I am studying the regeneration of carbon in old-growth boreal forests after they have been harvested for the first time.

#### Anticipated Graduate Coursework

-   Analyses et modélisation des données écologiques (Analysis and modeling of ecological data)
-   Engagement communautaire (Community engagement)
-   Communication scientifique et vulgarisation (Scientific communication and outreach)
-   Dendroécologie (Dendroecology)
-   Aménagement des écosystèmes forestiers (Forest ecosystem management)

## Northern Michigan University

I was awarded a Bachelors' of Science degree in Biology with a concentration in Ecology in December of 2024. I also earned minors in Earth Science and French. During my studies at Northern Michigan University, I was introduced to scientific research through courses like Ecology Theory and Methods and Plant Ecology. These courses followed the scientific process from beginning to end- from developing a question and collecting data to analyzing and presenting results. I also gained a deep appreciation for boreal ecosystems during my time at Northern through several field-based courses, during which I had the opportunity to closely study the forest in a structured yet open-ended manner.
